assertion_analysis.failure_condition: The diff adds no assertion; it changes only the test's parameters, adds an early pytest.skip off the GPU lane, and defaults the results directory to os.environ.get('NOVA_BOOK_RESULTS') or tmp_path. Reverting the skip (the negative control) restores the RuntimeError at scripts/prototypes/support/book.py:65 and reddens the six rows on CPU, so the guard is observable, but no committed assertion pins the skip reason.

The existing row assertions compare row['...'] fields against independent literals (net_current_relative_error <= 1e-12, budget ratios <= 1) read from measure()'s own receipts, not against a value the test passed in, so each can fail if the measurement regresses; none was changed by this diff.
